        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']
            return (b[0][0], b[0][1], b[2][0], b[2][1])

        before=history[i-1].frame
        after=history[i].frame
        bp_before=blue_pos(before)
        bp_after=blue_pos(after)
        if bp_before!=bp_after:
            print(i, act, bp_before, '->', bp_after)
